race.zenkai.passive.saiyan.desc: Recovering from near death leaves you stronger for a while.
race.zenkai.passive.namekian.desc: Your body knits itself back together far faster, spending ki to do it.
race.zenkai.passive.majin.desc: Physical blows barely dent you, and you mend on your own. Energy still hurts.
race.zenkai.passive.arcosian.desc: Cold cannot touch you, and your innate ki costs less to shape.
race.zenkai.passive.human.desc: You earn more from training and catch your breath faster than anyone.
skill.zenkai.fly.desc: Be able to fly using ki.
skill.zenkai.ki_control.desc: Channel your power output at 100%. Each level increases power output by 5%
skill.zenkai.meditation.desc: Channel your ki. Required to charge (C) at all; each level speeds up charging and passive ki regeneration.
skill.zenkai.ki_block.desc: Reinforce your guard with ki. Cuts 20% of incoming damage while blocking, up to 50% at max level.
skill.zenkai.ki_sense.desc: Feel the ki around you. Extends sensing range, reveals stamina and ki of those you sense, and lets you lock on to a target.
skill.zenkai.kaioken.desc: Multiply your power at the cost of your own body. Higher levels unlock stronger multipliers and reduce the health drain.
skill.zenkai.super_forms.desc: Awaken your potential and unlock your race's transformations, one per level.
skill.zenkai.god_ki.desc: Reach beyond your race's limit and unlock its divine transformation, one step per level.
skill.zenkai.ki_infuse.desc: Channel ki through your weapons and projectiles. Each level increases the damage your willpower adds to an infused strike, spent from your ki on top of the usual stamina cost.
skill.zenkai.ki_fist.desc: Wrap your fists in ki. Melee attacks and physical techniques hit harder the more spirit you have, spending ki on top of their usual stamina cost.
skill.zenkai.potential_unlock.desc: Draw out the power sleeping inside you. Costs no ki to hold, but locks you out of every other transformation.
skill.zenkai.instant_transmission.desc: Lock onto a ki signature or the point you're looking at and blink there instantly. Higher levels lower the ki cost and cooldown and extend the range, up to 64 blocks.

technique.zenkai.wave.desc: Kamehameha-style beam: slow to charge, but very strong.
technique.zenkai.blast.desc: Standard ball. Balanced in every way.
technique.zenkai.barrier.desc: Defensive bubble that follows you and absorbs damage. Doesn't attack.
technique.zenkai.burst.desc: Fires several small balls in a spread.
technique.zenkai.disk.desc: Cutting disk: pierces through everything it hits.
technique.zenkai.explosion.desc: Self-detonation centered on you: doesn't travel, doesn't aim.
technique.zenkai.spirit_bomb.desc: A signature technique only King Kai can teach: a slow, colossal sphere of gathered energy.
technique.zenkai.effect.explosive.desc: Breaks blocks in the blast radius. Costs more ki.
technique.zenkai.effect.piercing.desc: Passes through the first target hit and keeps flying.
technique.zenkai.effect.homing.desc: Gently curves toward your Ki Sense lock-on target.
technique.zenkai.effect.lingering.desc: Leaves a zone that keeps burning for a few seconds.
technique.zenkai.effect.fragmentation.de: Bursts into 3-4 smaller balls on impact.
